subject: Chemistry
source_note: TIE (2023), Chemistry Syllabus for Ordinary Secondary Education Form I-IV

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic concepts, theories and principles in Chemistry

sub_topics.title: . Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Chemistry
competences: (a) Explore the basic tenets of qualitative analysis (preliminary analysis, tests in solution and confirmatory test)
(b) Explore the basic tenets of Organic Chemistry (organic compounds; aliphatic hydrocarbons and alcohols)

objectives.text: (a) Explore the basic tenets of qualitative analysis (preliminary analysis, tests in solution and confirmatory test)
objectives.resources: Qualitative analysis reagents, apparatus for qualitative analysis, qualitative analysis sheets, wall charts and samples of salts
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic tenets of qualitative analysis are clearly decribed

objectives.text: (b) Explore the basic tenets of Organic Chemistry (organic compounds; aliphatic hydrocarbons and alcohols)
objectives.resources: Molecular models and organic substances present in environment
objectives.assessment_criteria: The basic tenets of Organic Chemistry are clearly explained

topics.title: Demonstrate mastery of basic terminologies in Chemistry

sub_topics.title: Use the International Union of Pure and Applied Chemistry nomenclature to name chemical species
competences: (a) Use Chemistry software to draw organic structures of hydrocarbons and alcohols with 1 carbon to 10 carbon atoms
(b) Name aliphatic hydrocarbons and alcohols with 1 carbon to 10 carbon atoms using the IUPAC system and Chemistry software

objectives.text: (a) Use Chemistry software to draw organic structures of hydrocarbons and alcohols with 1 carbon to 10 carbon atoms
objectives.resources: Chemistry-based computer software, organic model and wall chart
objectives.assessment_criteria: Organic structures of hydrocarbons and alcohols with 1 carbon to 10 carbon atoms are correctly drawn using the Chemistry software

objectives.text: (b) Name aliphatic hydrocarbons and alcohols with 1 carbon to 10 carbon atoms using the IUPAC system and Chemistry software
objectives.resources: Wall charts showing structures of hydrocarbons, molecular model kits, bottles/ containers containing labelled hydrocarbons and alcohols
objectives.assessment_criteria: Aliphatic hydrocarbons and alcohols with 1 carbon to 10 carbon atoms are correctly named using IUPAC system

sub_topics.title: Use chemical symbols, formulae and equations to represent chemical reaction
competences: (a) Describe the chemical reactions of aliphatic hydrocarbons and alcohols in relation to their structures

objectives.text: (a) Describe the chemical reactions of aliphatic hydrocarbons and alcohols in relation to their structures
objectives.teaching_methods: Gallery walk, Role play, Group discussion
objectives.resources: Wall charts, pictures and videos showing chemical reactions of aliphatic hydrocarbons and alcohols
objectives.assessment_criteria: Chemical reactions of aliphatic hydrocarbons and alcohols are described clearly in relation to their structures

sub_topics.title: Conduct experiments in Chemistry
competences: (a) Investigate the composition of chemical species in substances using systematic qualitative analysis
(b) Demonstrate the local and industrial preparations of aliphatic hydrocarbons and alcohols

objectives.text: (a) Investigate the composition of chemical species in substances using systematic qualitative analysis
objectives.resources: Qualitative analysis reagents, apparatus for qualitative analysis, qualitative analysis sheets, wall charts and samples of salts
objectives.assessment_criteria: The composition of chemical species in substances using systematic qualitative analysis are correctly investigated

objectives.text: (b) Demonstrate the local and industrial preparations of aliphatic hydrocarbons and alcohols
objectives.resources: Wall charts showing distillers, and relevant chemicals and solvents for preparation of alcohols and hydrocarbons with 1 carbon to 10 carbon atoms
objectives.assessment_criteria: The local and industrial preparation of aliphatic hydrocarbons and alcohols are clearly demonstrated

sub_topics.title: Conduct a project in Chemistry
competences: (a) Complete and submit a report for the project started in Form Three

objectives.text: (a) Complete and submit a report for the project started in Form Three
objectives.resources: Samples, project guidelines, sample of project reports and chemistry based software
objectives.assessment_criteria: Scientific report of the project is clearly written and quality project product(s) are obtained
